scripts.coverage: rm -rf ./coverage && forge -vvv coverage --ir-minimum --no-match-coverage 'test|node_modules|script' --report lcov && genhtml lcov.info --branch-coverage --output-dir coverage --ignore-errors inconsistent
scripts.deploy:sepolia: forge clean && forge script script/sepolia/deploy.sol:DeployScript --slow --broadcast --verify -vvv && npx tsx script/deplyment.ts --network sepolia
scripts.deploy:mainnet: forge clean && forge script script/mainnet/deploy.sol:DeployScript --slow --broadcast --verify -vvv && npx tsx script/deplyment.ts --network mainnet
